blazers.pulse: No game since Friday, so fans are still chewing on the 128-120 comeback win in Sacramento that made it 2-0. The vibe is glad for the W but uneasy about the defense, and some want the offense run through Deni Avdija more.
storylines: Portland came back from 12 down, powered by a 44-point third quarter, for its first road win
Rip City Project says the close call proves the Blazers must put the ball in Avdija's hands more after he took over in the second half
Defense worry: the Kings kept attacking Lillard and Morant, and Portland was slow closing out on corner threes
Shaedon Sharpe remains out with a torn right meniscus, expected back no earlier than February
Next up: at the Lakers on Tuesday

timbers.pulse: Finally! The Timbers beat Charlotte 3-2 at Providence Park on Alexander Aravena's header in the sixth minute of stoppage time. It snaps a seven-match winless run and pulls Portland within three points of the West's last playoff spot, so the season isn't dead yet.
storylines: Ariel Lassiter scored twice in the first half (11th and 40th minutes) before Charlotte fought back to 2-2
Aravena won it with a header deep in stoppage time
The win ended a seven-match winless streak
Portland is now within three points of the final Western Conference playoff spot
The loss kept Charlotte from clinching an East playoff berth

f1.pulse: Kimi Antonelli grabbed pole in Austin and could be world champion after Sunday's race. Ferrari owned Friday but faded when it counted, and Verstappen starts right alongside him, so nobody thinks it's a done deal.
storylines: Antonelli took pole with a 1:34.035, 0.179s ahead of Verstappen, with Hadjar third
Verstappen's final lap was deleted and he complained about grip afterward
Ferrari faded after topping both Friday practices: Leclerc starts 4th, Hamilton 5th
Russell starts 6th; Antonelli clinches with a win if Russell finishes 9th or lower and Hamilton 5th or lower
